description: Use when an agent judges whether a perp's funding is unusually high or low, or tracks open-interest build-up. Input: coin (e.g. BTC), hours (24-720, default 168). Output: current 1h funding and APR, 24h/7d/30d average APR, current percentile and z-score vs 7d and 30d, share of positive hours, downsampled series, open interest now and change 1h/24h/7d (from our 5-minute snapshots). Example: ?coin=BTC&hours=168 Price: $0.004 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

coin.description: Hyperliquid perp symbol (BTC, ETH, SOL, HYPE, kPEPE). Not listed → 400 before payment

hours.description: Window of the returned series in hours (24-720, default 168); statistics always cover 7 and 30 days

name: hl_funding_history
title: Hyperliquid funding rate history: percentiles, z-score, averages and open-interest change
